Problem Statement:
Write a program to print the multiplication table of 9 up to N terms using a loop. If the input is 0, print NULL.
Input Description:
A positive integer N (0
Output Description:
Print the first N multiples of 9 separated by a single space. If the input is 0, print NULL.
